    ARM: enable PMUv3 for the RPi4 Tizen defconfig
    
    Add CONFIG_ARM_PMUV3=y next to CONFIG_PROFILING. Cortex-A72 uses the
    arm_pmuv3 driver, but ARM_PMUV3 defaults to ARM64 so the 32-bit defconfig
    omits it, leaving the A72 PMU unbound and hardware perf events absent.
    
    Evidence: drivers/perf/Kconfig:146 (default ARM64),
    drivers/perf/arm_pmuv3.c:1383 (arm,cortex-a72-pmu), and
    drivers/perf/arm_v7_pmu.c:1947-1959 (match table without Cortex-A72).
    Only the normal ARM defconfig is changed; ARM64 and RT are unchanged.
    
    Change-Id: I39255cc161e0b1664c761bb3d7ed384a4120870e

diff --git a/arch/arm/configs/tizen_bcm2711_defconfig b/arch/arm/configs/tizen_bcm2711_defconfig
index bf97a71b2c3d..abdbb93e1765 100644
--- a/arch/arm/configs/tizen_bcm2711_defconfig
+++ b/arch/arm/configs/tizen_bcm2711_defconfig
@@ -31,6 +31,7 @@ CONFIG_SCHED_AUTOGROUP=y
 CONFIG_BLK_DEV_INITRD=y
 CONFIG_EXPERT=y
 CONFIG_PROFILING=y
+CONFIG_ARM_PMUV3=y
 CONFIG_ARCH_BCM=y
 CONFIG_ARCH_BCM2835=y
 CONFIG_ARM_LPAE=y
